newsitem.title: SPAIN: Panama says Eurobond to cut $100 mln off debt.
newsitem.headline: Panama says Eurobond to cut $100 mln off debt.

text.p: Panama said on Tuesday its inaugural Eurobond issue, launched in February, will reduce the Central American country's foreign debt by more than $100 million.

"The foreign debt will be reduced by more than $100 million thanks to the use of funds coming from the launch of its debut Eurobond," said Guillermo Chapman, Panama's minister for planning and economic policy.
Panama launched the five-year $500 million issue, its first operation in the Eurobond market, on February 10.

Chapman said the deal, priced at 175 basis points over Treasuries, was the largest amount launched at the lowest price for an inaugural sovereign deal from Latin America in the recent past. --Caroline Brothers, IADB newsroom +34 3 424 2834
